<?php

class TreeNode
{
    public ?TreeNode $left = null;
    public ?TreeNode $right = null;
    public function __construct(public int $value) {}
}

function insertNode(?TreeNode $node, int $value): TreeNode
{
    if ($node === null) {
        return new TreeNode($value);
    }
    if ($value < $node->value) {
        $node->left = insertNode($node->left, $value);
    } else {
        $node->right = insertNode($node->right, $value);
    }
    return $node;
}

function deleteNode(?TreeNode $node, int $value): ?TreeNode
{
    if ($node === null) {
        return null;
    }
    if ($value < $node->value) {
        $node->left = deleteNode($node->left, $value);
    } elseif ($value > $node->value) {
        $node->right = deleteNode($node->right, $value);
    } elseif ($node->left === null) {
        return $node->right;
    } elseif ($node->right === null) {
        return $node->left;
    } else {
        $successor = $node->right;
        while ($successor->left !== null) {
            $successor = $successor->left;
        }
        $node->value = $successor->value;
        $node->right = deleteNode($node->right, $successor->value);
    }
    return $node;
}

function traversal(?TreeNode $node, string $mode): array
{
    if ($node === null) {
        return [];
    }
    $left = traversal($node->left, $mode);
    $right = traversal($node->right, $mode);
    return match ($mode) {
        'inorder' => array_merge($left, [$node->value], $right),
        'preorder' => array_merge([$node->value], $left, $right),
        'postorder' => array_merge($left, $right, [$node->value]),
    };
}

function treeHeight(?TreeNode $node): int
{
    return $node === null ? 0 : 1 + max(treeHeight($node->left), treeHeight($node->right));
}

$tree = null;
foreach ([50, 27, 74, 13, 39, 62, 88, 6, 31, 45, 70, 34] as $value) {
    $tree = insertNode($tree, $value);
}
foreach (['inorder', 'preorder', 'postorder'] as $mode) {
    echo $mode, ': ', implode(' ', traversal($tree, $mode)), "\n";
}
$queue = [$tree];
$levelorder = [];
$head = 0;
while ($head < count($queue)) {
    $node = $queue[$head++];
    $levelorder[] = $node->value;
    if ($node->left !== null) {
        $queue[] = $node->left;
    }
    if ($node->right !== null) {
        $queue[] = $node->right;
    }
}
printf("levelorder: %s\nheight: %d\n", implode(' ', $levelorder), treeHeight($tree));
$tree = deleteNode($tree, 6);
$tree = deleteNode($tree, 27);
printf(
    "preorder after deletions: %s\nheight after deletions: %d\n",
    implode(' ', traversal($tree, 'preorder')),
    treeHeight($tree),
);
